newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves BALCO's cold rolling mill proposal.
newsitem.headline: India approves BALCO's cold rolling mill proposal.

text.p: The Indian government has approved a proposal by the state-run Bharat Aluminium Company Ltd (BALCO) to set up a cold rolling mill with an annual capacity of 40,000 tonnes, a Mines Ministry statement said on Friday.
The new rolling mill will cost 1.58 billion rupees ($44 million), based on prices prevailing in the last quarter of 1996, and make sheets and gauges under 0.4 mm in thickness, the statement said.
The mill will be completed in three years from the start of construction.
